description: This file is a Perl script that processes the output of 'git verify-pack -v' to generate statistics and information about Git packfiles, including sizes, delta chains, and optional tree/depth information.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (min, max, total, mean, median, std_dev) for a list of numerical values.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints formatted statistical metrics for a dataset.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses the delta trees starting from root objects, collecting sizes and path sizes, optionally printing detailed tree structure.
